players.product: Wormhole / Blackhole Tensix AI accelerators (RISC-V) and licensable RISC-V CPU / AI chiplet IP

quarterly_data.signal: Tenstorrent released the open-source beta of its Open Chiplet Atlas (OCA) Harness, a chiplet design framework with the complete Harness RTL (security processor as root of trust, system management controller, debug and test ports, and AXI4 over UCIe die-to-die links) plus a C++/SystemC virtual platform; BOS Semiconductors contributed the original AXI over UCIe RTL and lowRISC helped open-source it. The full release is targeted for January 2027.
